# Hellish Rebuke (`spells:hellish-rebuke`)
**Level 1 [Evocation](../magic-schools/evocation.md)** | **Casting Time:** Reaction, which you take in response to taking damage from a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself | **Range:** 60 feet
**Components:** V, S | **Duration:** Instantaneous | **Classes:** [Warlock](../classes/warlock.md)
**Damage Type:** [Fire](../damage-types/fire.md)

The creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by green flames. It makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.

| Slot Level | Damage |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2d10 |
